lines: Recent Patch: one overall buff or nerf note per skill (from the average hit) in place of a note on each Min / Max line.
Recent Patch: a skill's changed base damage (Spell Min/Max, Damage Min/Max) now shows about how big the buff or nerf is.

Patch 96 game data. The game rewrote most skill, support and passive texts; several rules the planner reads from them (Hunter's Mark and Called Shot, totem shot rate, trap re-arm, Orbit's repeat hits, Ancestral Host and Siege Pact, Kindled Remains, Hallowed Stand) now read the new wording. Without this fix, builds using Hunter's Marks lost them in the sim.
Trap: a trap on a totem or Ballista no longer takes the 35% less, and a thrown trap's first strike deals 40% more (averaged over the trap's 16 seconds).
Cast on Crit on its own in an attack: when no other attack on your bar can set it off, the attack's own crits strike it again (at most once every 0.75 s, 58% less damage).

Blood Ledger no longer reserves 15% of your life in the EHP. Rending Slam's life share is no longer raised by Facebreaker. The Venom Golem's extra damage taken counts on Entropy implosions again (the Training Post was fixed to match). "Auras reserve a third less mana" covers every Vow and Herald.

Entropy: on hallowed ground, Inevitable Judgement no longer raises the Entropy your hits lay (its bigger crits only reach the struck part). The Venom Golem's 7.5% more damage taken no longer counts on Entropy implosions. Both from game logs on the Training Post (Patch 95); a Paladin build there went from 59M to 43M in the sim, against 42M on the Post.

Ancestral Warrior: Multistrike, Afterimage and Repeat lines (supports, gear or the passive tree) no longer raise the statue's slam. The statue slams on its own timer in the game, so they change nothing.
Dragonling: an Optimize button next to Refund all plans just the Dragonling tree (and its Aspect) for your skill. Your passive tree and Oaths stay as they are.
Orbiting Hammers: Multiple Projectiles now adds its 2 extra hammers to the ring, as in the game (it was only counted as 15% less damage).

Entropy: with Quiet Ruin and Entropic Overload, your spell crits still set off your Entropy (game log, Patch 95). Skills that lay Entropy with both keystones no longer show 0 damage from it, and Woe of Entropy counts for them.
Kindled Remains: corpse bursts use the support's current shares (12.6% / 25.2% / 28.8% of the corpse's life, grown by the skill's damage); an old table was used by mistake.

Blood Ledger: a Blood Ledger Slam on the bar sets off every skill's Entropy when it triggers (game log, Patch 95). Its 15% of maximum Life held back now counts on the defence side: EHP and max hit use the life you can use, shown in a new 'Life you can use' row.

Chinese, Spanish and Russian: the New Players and Advanced tabs, Skill Scaling's 'How to make it stronger' notes, the Configure Enemy rows and newer Build Planner and Item Simulator lines are translated.
Skill Scaling: hover a card's 'Changed in Patch N' tile to see what that patch changed.
Passive tree: icons for Focus, Singular Will, Boundless Mind, Bastion's Reckoning, Thousand Feathers and Oath of the Rolling Thunder.
Pyre of Faith: its burn no longer lays ailments of its own (no ignite, poison, bleed or chill), as in the game since Patch 95. Its damage against a rare can read lower; its sheet DPS is unchanged.

Cast on Crit: Ballista, Ancestral Warrior and Horn of Jarls (totem skills), Unholy Void and Pyre of Faith no longer cast a linked spell on their crits, as in Patch 95 (tested in game for the Ballista). Arrow Totem shots still do.
Recent Patch: In short lines for Patch 95 (Trap Support, support and skill lifts, Golem and Skeletal Mage growth, Area passives).
Sim Supports: the progress bar no longer sits at 91% during the last passes, and an error ends the search with the setups found so far.

Oaths: a seat now opens with any notable of its cluster, as in the game since build 94, not only the notable next to it. Oaths sworn that way (for example Oath of the Stone Root with only Oathstone Body taken) were left out before, so life, armour and damage could read lower than in the game.

Tree optimizer: with Keep defence notables on, Entropy notables (such as Stillness Before Ruin) were kept as if they were defence notables, even after you took out Chaos support. They are now refunded when they add nothing.

Gear finders (Gear Set Sim, Sim by Slot, Best Rivenstone): skills that use two-handed weapons, such as Cyclone, Slash and Leap Slam, are now tried with two-handed swords, axes, maces and spears. Before, only scythes, staves and paired weapons were tried, so Oathwords like Maelstrom were suggested on a scythe.

Empty sockets on a skill gem below level 20 now cost what the game log shows: more than before for gems of level 11 to 19 (a level 17 gem with 2 of 5 supports deals 57% of its damage, we showed 69%). Fully linked skills and level 20 gems are unchanged.

Way of the Blade (Samurai keystone) and other repeat lines from gear or the passive tree no longer add a repeat to Cyclone or other channelled skills; as the keystone says, channelled skills never repeat. The tree optimizer had been suggesting Way of the Blade for Cyclone builds because of this.
Also count list: a Cast on Crit skill shows "with main" in place of a weight, since its damage adds to the main skill's.
Cyclone: it pulses at most every 0.1 s; attack speed past that adds nothing. Your weapon's own attacks per second does not change how fast it spins, only your attack speed lines do (tested in game).
Dual wielding: your swings alternate between the two weapons, so the damage is now the average of both (it used only the main hand). The 25% more attack speed for two weapons is now checked in game.
Dexterity gives attack speed again even when it is not your highest attribute (game patch 94, tested on a Warrior and a Ranger).
Bastion's Reckoning: its 6% less Attack and Cast Speed now slows attacks too, as in the game.

Hunter's Patience and other "after you stand still" lines: the game's character sheet leaves them out, so the hit and panel DPS here do too. The vs-enemy DPS still counts them while you fight standing still.

Temper every support gem: a new setting (on, level 5) counts each support at that Forge Tempering level everywhere; a gem tempered higher keeps its own level. Turn it off to use only the levels from your save.
